title.en: Milestone — Final Project Video: 5-Minute AI Pitch
title.es: Hito — Vídeo del proyecto final: pitch de IA en 5 minutos

description.en: Record a ~5-minute landscape pitch of the AI system you built for your company: hook, problem, live demo, engineering trade-offs, and a cut-ready 4Geeks Q&A. Deliver a Google Drive (or similar) folder with the MP4, a 1–2 sentence description, and the signed media release.
description.es: Graba un pitch horizontal de ~5 minutos del sistema de IA que construiste para tu empresa: gancho, problema, demo en vivo, trade-offs de ingeniería y un Q&A de 4Geeks listo para cortar. Entrega una carpeta de Google Drive (o similar) con el MP4, una descripción de 1–2 frases y la cesión de imagen firmada.

delivery.instructions: Submit a Google Drive (or similar) folder link with FirstnameLastname-ProjectName.mp4 (MP4, 1080p if possible), FirstnameLastname-ProjectName-description.txt (1–2 sentences), and the signed media release. Anyone with the link must be able to view.
